caption:
How to summarize a long document with AI in 5 bullet points

New supplier terms, a lease, a policy update: pages you know you should read, and probably won't.

Copy this:

"Summarize this in 5 bullet points for a busy small business owner. Lead with what changes for me, dates and deadlines, and anything I'm agreeing to pay. Then 2 questions I should ask before I sign. Document: [PASTE TEXT]"

On an invented set of supplier terms, the first bullet was the one that mattered: invoices due in 14 days instead of 30. The questions at the end were the ones I'd want to ask.

Use the bullets to find what matters, then read those parts in full before you sign anything. Remove account numbers and private details before pasting.

Send this to someone who still signs things they only skimmed. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
